rules: Only known and reachable locations may be selected.
Best physical habitability does not automatically win; logistics and founding motive matter.
Protected/pre-warp sapient worlds are ineligible for colonization through this system.
Contacted sovereign worlds require treaty grant, invitation or joint-colony authority.
Existing foreign claims create dispute risk rather than silently transferring ownership.
Non-sapient biospheres may impose environmental restrictions rather than being treated as empty terrain.
Unknown data remains unknown; the scorer may lower confidence or reject rather than inventing certainty.
scoring_note: Reference scores are deterministic implementation aids, not universal visible gameplay stats.
